name: shamir-share-then-repair
note: Threshold-3 Shamir over F_7: f(x) = s + a1 x + a2 x^2, share i is f(i). An eavesdropper holds share 1. Node 2 is then replaced and helpers 3 and 4 send their shares to the new node in the clear; the eavesdropper reads both helper transcripts. The third observation completes a threshold set and the secret leaks.
